programme.title: The Integrity of Joseph Chambers
programme.desc: Struggling with feelings of inadequacy, an ordinary man vows to prove his masculinity and ability to provide for his family by embarking on a solo off-the-grid expedition in the woods to hunt for deer. As he ventures deeper into the forest, he soon realizes he wanders deeper into his own psyche and the root of his motivations.

programme.title: On the Edge
programme.desc: One night, Leo, a Spaniard working in Brussels as a subway driver, sees a young man on the edge of the platform, just before he falls onto the tracks.

programme.title: Warrior Strong
programme.desc: To save the career he endangered with his hotheaded attitude, professional basketball player Bilal Irving takes on a new job - coaching the failing basketball team in his hometown of Dumont, Ontario. He's got just one obstacle: his former coach, whose ideas about coaching vastly differ from that of Bilal's. The two will have to put aside their differences and their attitudes if this small-town team is to have any chance at winning.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: Terminally uncool club-hopping brothers Doug and Steve Butabi---first seen strutting their head-bobbing stuff on "Saturday Night Live"---struggle to make it through the doors of the elite Roxbury Club and hobnob with "hotties." Chris Kattan, Will Ferrell, Dan Hedaya, Loni Anderson, Molly Shannon, Colin Quinn, Gigi Rice, Elisa Donovan, Meredith Scott Lynn, Jennifer Coolidge.

programme.title: Zeroville
programme.desc: In 1969, an aspiring young actor makes a voyage to Los Angeles to make his break in Hollywood. However, the film industry finds itself amidst a significantly turbulent period, which may affect the futures of young actors and actresses for years afterward.

programme.title: Dream Horse
programme.desc: This comedy film is about Jan Vokes, a Welsh bartender who comes up with the idea of breeding a horse intended for racing. Since she lives in a town that is down on its luck, her neighbors start pitching in and participate in financing for the horse. They see the horse as their chance of redeeming their town and lifting their spirits as it races up the ranks, hopefully to become a champion thoroughbred. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Irena's Vow
programme.desc: This period film is set during the German occupation of Poland in the 1940s. Based on true accounts, the drama follows Irene Gut Opdyke, a nineteen-year-old hotel kitchen worker hired by Rugmer, a Nazi official. She was later promoted as a housekeeper to serve in Rugmer's home, where, unbeknownst to him, she also managed to shelter twelve Jews in the cellar.

programme.title: The Other Woman
programme.desc: Jack leaves his wife for Emilia, only to find his new marriage marked by tragedy. His son William seems intent on making Emilia's life miserable, and their union takes a sharp turn for the worse when their newborn baby dies suddenly.

programme.title: Certain Women
programme.desc: A lawyer deals with a hostage crisis in this ensemble drama about women living in Montana. Elsewhere, a wife and mother tries to build a cottage home, and a female farm worker falls for a young woman who teaches adult-education classes.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: The story of two criminals with different ambitions, set to music. Two small-time criminals, Mike and Troy, are looking for that one big score and think they've found it. Meeting at a secluded cafe for the handover, they wait as danger moves ever closer. While waiting, Troy falls for the waitress, Gloria, and begins to question his life choices. But it may be too late for him to change his future before it comes to an abrupt end.

programme.title: Agent Game
programme.desc: Harris, a CIA interrogator at an Agency black site, finds himself the target of a rendition operation after being scapegoated for an interrogation gone horribly wrong. As the team tasked to bring Harris in begins to question their orders -- and each other --Olsen, a senior intelligence officer, and his subordinate, Visser, raise the stakes. Now, it's up to Harris and some newfound allies to uncover the truth and turn the tables.

programme.title: Fear the Night
programme.desc: Tes, a former Iraqi war veteran, is called back to action when a group of invaders decides to crash her sister's bachelorette party. She quickly realizes that these people are going to leave no one behind, and she must fight to stay alive. With the safety of an entire party resting on her shoulders, Tes can't afford to make any mistakes.

programme.title: The Aviary
programme.desc: After years spent oppressed by a sinister cult, two women escape into the unforgiving New Mexican desert. Yet their relief is short-lived as paranoia sets in, and the women fear discovery by the cruel, charismatic cult leader. The women must then overcome their inner demons if they are to escape with their lives.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer discovers the firm he's hired into is controlled by the mob and attempts to escape from their clutches.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The true story of WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange and his epic struggle against the US government over classified intelligence documents that were exposed for public scrutiny.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: The marches to secure voting rights for black Americans are depicted in this docudrama set during the US Civil Rights Movement, and which focuses on the actions of Martin Luther King Jr.

programme.title: Military Wives
programme.desc: A group of English women find themselves without their husbands as they leave to serve in Afghanistan. In response, they band together to form a choir on a military base. Their group then attracts massive media attention, igniting what begins to develop into a global movement.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: This comedy-drama follows a dog over the course of several lives and owners as he learns his purpose.

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Growing up in a small South Korean town, Hae Sung and Nora shared a deep, inextricable bond that was suddenly torn asunder by Nora's family's emigration to the United States. Twenty years later, the childhood sweethearts inexplicably cross paths and share one emotionally-charged week that forces them to confront long-dormant feelings and their hopes for the future.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: An explorer and his sidekick search for treasure and help a doctor contain a plague in Africa.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: An inept criminal's girlfriend is kidnapped while he is in Mexico trying to pull off one final job.

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Chilling thriller about a social-climbing psychopath who insinuates himself into the lives of a wealthy playboy and his girlfriend.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Tom Cruise guns the engine in this action drama about a stock-car racer.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: A recent divorcee becomes entangled in a mystery involving her former husband and his new family.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: After her mother's death, 13-year-old Becky goes on a weekend getaway with her father, Jeff, to bond and reconnect with him. Jeff, however, has a different plan?he brings along his new girlfriend Kayla in an attempt to bring her closer to Becky. However, when four newly-escaped prisoners show up and break into the lake house they are staying at, their plans change, and the fun trip becomes a nightmare. Becky now has to do everything she can to keep the three of them safe.

programme.title: Oldboy
programme.desc: After being held prisoner and framed for his wife's murder by an unknown person, a Korean businessman is released after 15 years and is given five days to discover the identity of his captor.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: The lives of four friends following their involvement in a holdup.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: Tom Cruise guns the engine in this action drama about a stock-car racer.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: An inept criminal's girlfriend is kidnapped while he is in Mexico trying to pull off one final job.

programme.title: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: In the 1930s, giant robots attack New York City, and a reporter teams up with ace aviator and former flame Joseph "Sky Captain" Sullivan to stop them before the world is destroyed.

programme.title: The Last Voyage of the Demeter
programme.desc: In the late nineteenth century, the Russian schooner Demeter embarks on an unusual quest, carrying twenty-four unmarked crates from Carpathia to London. Their voyage seems doomed from the start, given their suspicious orders, as a malevolent presence preys upon each member of the crew. When the ship arrives, at last, in Whitby Harbour, the crew is nowhere to be found. The story is based on a chapter from Bram Stoker's Dracula.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: A sharpshooting FBI agent goes undercover as a surfer to stop a crime wave.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: John Woo's slick techno-thriller about a brilliant engineer who tries to reconstruct the past after his memory is erased.

programme.title: Rounders
programme.desc: A reformed gambler leaves the poker table behind to become a law student, but reluctantly returns to his old way of life when his friend is threatened by loan sharks.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
programme.desc: Sergio Leone's tribute to Hollywood Westerns concerns a mysterious gunfighter out for vengeance.

programme.desc: A betrayed mob hit man goes the lam with his son, and seeks revenge against vicious gangsters. As the bullets start to fly, the impressionable child is exposed to the goriest aspects of his father's talents in this gorgeously stylized action thriller.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: In the 1860s western frontier, the fiercely independent Vivienne Le Coudy joins her lover Holger Olsen in Elk Flats, Nevada. But the Civil War tears them apart, leaving Vivienne to fight corrupt Mayor Schiller and his ruthless partner. When Holger returns, they must confront their changed selves amidst a landscape of love, betrayal, and the struggle for justice.

programme.title: Hell or High Water

programme.title: The Machinist
programme.desc: An insomniac factory worker is involved in an accident at work and begins receiving cryptic notes at home and having visions of a co-worker nobody else can see.

programme.title: Singularity
programme.desc: In 2020, a supercomputer determines that human beings pose the greatest threat to Earth, and begins an eradication process. Decades later, a teen struggles to survive in a world dominated by machines in this haunting sci-fi thriller.

As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. programme.title: Lethal Weapon 2

programme.title: Lethal Weapon 4
programme.desc: Detective Riggs (Mel Gibson) tries to settle down with his pregnant girlfriend, Lorna (Rene Russo), while his partner, Murtaugh (Danny Glover), comes to grips with the marriage of his pregnant daughter, Rianne (Traci Wolfe), to fellow cop Butters (Chris Rock). programme.desc: In an alternate 1980s, the United States stands alone as communism grows stronger. When Soviet soldiers invade a small Colorado town, brothers Jed (Patrick Swayze) and Matt Eckert (Charlie Sheen) escape with friends to the forest. With their father, Tom (Harry Dean Stanton), a prisoner of the invading army, the children decide to fight against the Soviets. As the country comes under increasing attack, the group teams up with Lt. Col. Andrew Tanner (Powers Boothe) to take back their town.

programme.title: Lethal Weapon
programme.desc: Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first.

programme.title: Lethal Weapon 2
programme.desc: South African smugglers find themselves being hounded and harassed by Riggs and Murtaugh, two mismatched Los Angeles police officers. However, the South Africans are protected by diplomatic immunity, and so the two are assigned to witness-protection duty in an attempt by their captain to keep his job. It is only when this witness reveals to them that he has already dealt with the smugglers that the trouble really starts.

programme.title: Lethal Weapon 3
programme.desc: Veteran police detective Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover) is only days away from retiring when he and his tough partner, Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson), are roped into an important internal affairs case. Working with the beautiful, no-nonsense Sergeant Lorna Cole (Rene Russo) and aided by the shifty informant Leo Getz (Joe Pesci), Murtaugh and Riggs begin to close in on a black-market weapons operation involving corrupt cop and arms dealer Jack Travis (Stuart Wilson).

programme.title: Lethal Weapon 4
programme.desc: Detective Riggs (Mel Gibson) tries to settle down with his pregnant girlfriend, Lorna (Rene Russo), while his partner, Murtaugh (Danny Glover), comes to grips with the marriage of his pregnant daughter, Rianne (Traci Wolfe), to fellow cop Butters (Chris Rock). But they find themselves and their families targeted by Chinese mobsters, led by Wah Sing Ku (Jet Li). Riggs, Murtaugh, Butters and private eye Getz (Joe Pesci) decide to go on the offensive before the gangsters get to their loved ones.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: When the mayor of a crime-ridden city loosens the restrictions on entering the police academy in order to get more cops on the street, all manner of oddball characters enlist to join the force. Among the cadets are suave Carey Mahoney (Steve Guttenberg), hulking Moses Hightower (Bubba Smith), beautiful Karen Thompson (Kim Cattrall) and sound effects-generating Larvell Jones (Michael Winslow), who all have to show initiative and courage when they are faced with tough situations out on patrol.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment

Pete Lassard (Howard Hesseman), whose district is being harassed by a gang led by Zed (Bob Goldthwait). Given 30 days to shape up or lose his post, Lassard struggles to discipline his incompetent new charges, while subordinate Lt. Mauser (Art Metrano) plots to take his job away.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians, former showgirl Rachel Phelps (Margaret Whitton), has a sweetheart deal to move the team to Miami. But to break the lease with the city of Cleveland, ticket sales have to plummet. So Phelps hires the most incompetent players available, including near-blind pitcher Rick Vaughn (Charlie Sheen) and injury-prone catcher Jake Taylor (Tom Berenger). But her villainous tactics accidentally foster a can-do team spirit, turning the Indians into potential winners.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Cleveland Indians, an endearing assortment of oddballs who improbably won the division championship last season, have since lost their edge due to personal pursuits and the excesses of fame. Rick Wild Thing Vaughn (Charlie Sheen) does lucrative endorsements, but his killer fastball is gone, while once-aggressive slugger Pedro Cerrano (Dennis Haysbert) has become a laid-back Buddhist. But, as the players realize they've all gone astray, they rally for a shot at the World Series.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: In Durham, N.C., the Bulls minor league baseball team has one asset no other can claim: a poetry-loving groupie named Annie Savoy (Susan Sarandon).
